notes.title: Welcome our new horror game!
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

Besides working on anime games, I have something else in store for you. I'd like to introduce you to our new horror game in a Christmas setting. Watch the video, tell me your impression of the game, and don't forget to add it to your wishlist if you liked it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741420/

notes.title: Check out the new anime game!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

I finally finished most of the work of the new anime shooter game. Check it out, and don't forget to [b]wishlist it[/b]! It's important for devs :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992640/

[b]You can also have a look at the DLC for it.[/b]

notes.title: Neko Secret - Homecoming
notes.content:
Hello!

We are releasing our new anime style game soon! Check it out here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1834960

If you like it, please, add to your wishlist!

notes.title: Added darts minigame!
Added breast physics!
notes.content: Hello! In the last mini update we've added breast bouncing animation. Also, the body modifiers from customization are now applying to the starting scene.
